description: Domain Age Lifecycle & SEO Authority Evaluation Brackets

brackets.seoStrategy: Consolidate top 3 SERP rankings, refresh legacy high-value URLs, and expand into competitive head terms.

Established entity authority and brand signals
Consistently fast indexing of newly published content

brackets.seoStrategy: Dominate industry head keywords; defend market share with high-velocity digital PR and comprehensive topic coverage.
keySignals: Immense historical link equity and brand affinity
Maximum algorithmic trust across competitive search spaces
